references.text: Matthew confirms and theologically expands on the same lineage by including Rahab and Ruth, which underscores God's grace in salvation history.
This version in Chronicles confirms the historical reliability of the lineage in Ruth by presenting the same fatherhood without the narrative details.
Chronicles fills out the historical context by showing that Salmon (Salma) is the son of Nahshon, thus forming the complete line before Boaz.
Luke confirms the same lineage in Jesus' genealogy, which theologically anchors the Messiah in David's house as Ruth foretold.
